body.p: Use component buttons to simulate ClickTrig; Confirm/Cancel writes ConfirmBtn/CancelBtn; output fields show ActivePopup state.
PLC map: DB_Components.Valve01/Heater01/Fan01.ClickTrig -> HMI popup FB1 -> DB_ActivePopup.*
For live PLC binding: write DB_Components.* and read DB_ActivePopup.Visible/ActiveID/Confirmed/InfoTitle/InfoMessage.
Note: internal HMI tags are for simulation; later bind each IOField ProcessValue to PLC connection tags.
